missions.objective: Make the canonical prediction contract temporally eligible, numerically finite and causally non-misleading at the CeutIA receiver.
missions.scientific_rationale: Prediction and causal inference are distinct epistemic claims; causal abstention must not invalidate a predictive forecast. Point-in-time availability and finite intervals are mandatory.
missions.engineering_rationale: Receiver previously omitted decision-time eligibility, rejected causal abstention and allowed NaN lower/upper values through the interval-ordering check.
missions.result: Corrections implemented; adversarial suite added and workflow updated to execute it. Previous run 11 failed before the receiver-time fix because the test called the new decision_time argument before the consumer had been updated.
missions.remaining_work: Run 13 on the current head must complete successfully before validation can advance.

missions.objective: Emit the CeutIA-owned canonical v1.1 scientific prediction contract from a real SERPIENTE Forecast without inventing applicability metadata.
missions.scientific_rationale: Model/method identity, training window, reference class, OOD state, calibration and provenance must be explicit; missing applicability evidence must not be converted into a positive claim.
missions.engineering_rationale: The older CeutIAPredictionEnvelope lacks the scientific metadata required by the new contract.
missions.result: Producer adapter implemented; producer tests pin the exact CeutIA canonical contract hash 672dfa6b60d2e8c0854a024e83acf6b23eed44f2cd3293708aee533d7a9dc1f0. Runtime run 90 was cancelled by the subsequent PostgreSQL parity push; run 91 is queued on the parity fix.
missions.remaining_work: Validate run 91 and establish an actual transport/receiver execution path.

missions.objective: Close the SQLite/PostgreSQL forecast-outcome referential-integrity parity defect and revalidate concurrency/persistence behaviour.
missions.scientific_rationale: An orphan outcome cannot be linked to a forecast and invalidates prospective forecast evaluation.
missions.engineering_rationale: SQLite rejected orphan outcomes after hardening; PostgreSQL previously accepted them. PostgreSQL is now aligned and has a dedicated regression test.
missions.result: PostgreSQL parity defect corrected and test added. Runtime run 91 is queued; no green claim.
missions.remaining_work: Read run 91 and, if green, continue canonical serialization and transaction-boundary parity audit.

missions.objective: Connect the canonical scientific prediction contract to the actual CeutIA decision endpoint so compatibility validation is executable at the governance boundary.
missions.scientific_rationale: A compatibility function or unit test is not sufficient if the live decision path can still consume an older envelope and bypass the scientific gate.
missions.engineering_rationale: Direct source inspection shows /decision/evaluate still accepts the legacy SerpientePredictionEnvelope and does not invoke consume_serpiente_prediction.
missions.result: Gap confirmed; endpoint integration has not yet been changed.
missions.remaining_work: Perform an impact-preserving endpoint integration and persist the canonical prediction reference.

missions.objective: Establish authenticated transport and integrity verification for canonical prediction delivery rather than relying on payload hashing alone.
missions.scientific_rationale: Integrity detects payload alteration but does not authenticate the producer; provenance must include trustworthy producer identity.
missions.engineering_rationale: The v1.1 contract has an integrity hash but no authentication mechanism and no executable transport path.
missions.result: Mission generated by cross-repository contract audit; no transport code yet.
missions.remaining_work: Implement only after endpoint contract is fixed to avoid two competing ingress mechanisms.

missions.objective: Persist the complete canonical prediction record and link it to decisions without treating the forecast as a model release.
missions.scientific_rationale: Prospective evaluation requires reconstructable prediction identity, timing, method metadata, calibration/OOD status and exact forecast payload.
missions.engineering_rationale: Current CeutIA persistence has decision lineage and audit records but no dedicated canonical prediction record; the endpoint currently stores only prediction_id in its gate audit payload.
missions.result: Gap confirmed by persistence source inspection.
missions.remaining_work: Design the smallest dedicated prediction table/record and explicit lineage reference.

missions.objective: Reconstruct a prediction exactly as known at decision time and prevent future information from entering replay.
missions.scientific_rationale: Prospective validation fails if replay uses revised or later-acquired information unavailable at forecast origin.
missions.engineering_rationale: Both repositories have point-in-time mechanisms, but the canonical prediction record is not yet wired into replay.
missions.result: Mission generated from persistence and temporal audit.
missions.remaining_work: Implement after durable prediction record exists.
